expectations.note: Cassette selected showed the screen row at index 5 immediately followed by the cassette variant row at index 6 with abutting 45px rects; the rendered capture showed both rows adjacent and legible.
I tapped the screen row through cassette, spectrum, polo, dot, and void, observing each displayed value, and direct screen commands independently landed on the named screens.
The cassette variant row advanced on its own tap, and direct cassettevariant calls changed the underlying setting with the row updating to the selected artwork label.
Spectrum, polo, dot, and void each omitted the cassette-only row; their own controls remained present and representative controls changed when tapped after scrolling into view.
The final genuine PNG capture visibly shows the Settings sheet with screen=cassette and the adjacent screen/variant rows readable in one frame.
The final semantics snapshot independently reports screen=cassette at index 5 and variant at index 6, matching the screenshot and its Minimal value.
Across the captured screen states, unrelated rows retained their order; transport and browser both responded to on-screen taps with changed displayed values.
After repeated screen changes, scrolling, variant changes, and settings close/reopen, the app remained live and the runtime overflow ring was empty.
